paper.abstract_en: The no-signalling principle lies at the heart of Bell-type experiments involving spacelike-separated parties. Although not all no-signalling correlations can be realized within quantum theory, the no-sinalling principle itself remains fundamental even for post-quantum theories, since its violation would imply superluminal signalling. In the spirit of device independent nature of the Bell inequalities, there has recently been growing interest in causal inequalities, which identify correlations admitting no causal explanation. Such correlations have been rigorously studied within the process-matrix formalism, which is built upon a constraint analogous to spacelike separation in Bell scenarios. We refer to this constraint as the single-interaction constraint, whereby each party interacts with the environment only once. Despite considerable effort, no fundamental guiding principle is currently known that characterizes the restrictions this constraint imposes on the correlations generated by Process Matrices. In this work, we address this gap by proposing a generalized causality principle for the bipartite case. We show that for certain cases, the generalised causality principle defines a strict subset of the set of all signalling correlations. This principle thus provides a fundamental limit on quantum and even post-quantum theories subject to the single-interaction constraint. By analogy with no-signalling, whose violation excludes certain causal structures among the parties, a violation of the generalised causality principle rules out a corresponding class of causal structures(causal structures with the single interaction constraint). More broadly, our techniques provide a general framework for deriving generalised causal constraints, applicable to a wide class of indefinite-causal-order scenarios.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文以过程矩阵形式主义为基础，提出二体情形下的广义因果性原则，并讨论其对单次相互作用约束下相关集合的限制，属于因果结构基础问题，理论深度较高；摘要给出明确假设、框架与适用范围，但尚无同行评议或引用信号，且元数据不完整（无分类、无DOI、无期刊信息），故综合评分中等。
decision.abstract_zh: 无信号原理是涉及类空间隔各方的 Bell 型实验的核心。尽管并非所有无信号关联都能在量子理论内实现，但无信号原理本身即便对于后量子理论仍然是基本的，因为违反它将意味着超光速信号传递。本着 Bell 不等式设备无关特性的精神，近来人们对因果不等式日益关注，这些不等式识别出不容许因果解释的关联。此类关联已在过程矩阵形式主义内被严格研究，该形式主义建立在一个类似于 Bell 场景中类空间隔的约束之上。我们称此约束为单次相互作用约束，即每一方仅与环境相互作用一次。尽管付出了相当多的努力，目前尚不知道有哪个基本指导原则刻画了这一约束对由过程矩阵生成的关联所施加的限制。在本工作中，我们通过为二体情形提出一个广义因果性原则来填补这一空白。我们表明，在某些情形下，广义因果性原则定义的是所有信号关联集合的一个真子集。因此，这一原则为受单次相互作用约束的量子乃至后量子理论提供了一个基本限制。通过与无信号原理类比——违反无信号原理排除了各方之间某些因果结构——违反广义因果性原则排除了相应的一类因果结构（带有单次相互作用约束的因果结构）。更广泛地说，我们的技术提供了一个推导广义因果约束的一般框架，适用于一大类不定因果序场景。
